Pioneer preview: the next update

A first look at the next update (version 0.53.1), as it appears in the Pioneer test build checked on 25 November 2026. Pioneer content can still change, move or be dropped before it reaches the regular servers.

Read this first

Preview, not confirmed in-game. Everything below comes from the Pioneer build. Values show how things are set up right now, not how they will feel in play, and release dates are unknown unless the official notes give one. Where the official update notes already describe a change, that is mentioned.
  • New Tatari: the Sharpup line (Sharpup, Scrawurst, Sketchund, Scribbadger), a Rock DPS that fights with pencils.
  • New mode: Whirling Wallop, a merge-and-defend mode with 11 named stages and element bonuses.
  • Island Goldrush: more Super Drinks from daily team ranks, bigger final rewards in leagues 2–4 and a new per-Mirage exhaustion.
  • City of Gold pass with a Maple Mansion Pinball Machine skin, camp Blueprints, six new camp encounters and 51 new collectibles.
  • Horde Invasion: clearer chip and skill wording, plus several Zobo skill adjustments.

New Tatari: Sharpup line

ElementRolePositionGlitter forms
RockDPSMiddleAll four tiers

Sharpup launches piercing pencils for 160% ATK, with damage decreasing as they travel. Every fourth attack uses an eraser for 180% ATK and dispels enemy buffs. Normal targeting range is 4 tiles at T1 and 6 tiles at T2–T4; the T1 pencil itself can travel 4.2 tiles.

Skill cards sit side by side. Swipe or scroll sideways to compare all four evolutions and the three Horde upgrades.

New mode: Whirling Wallop

Drag and merge Tatari to defend the camp van, using contraptions on each map such as oil barrels you can smash open. Your Tatari’s weapons spin around them automatically and hit any Zobo that gets close. Stages must be cleared in order, can be replayed, and each stage’s reward can be claimed once.

Five families take part: Frostnip, Blueflick, Manteeny, Punchimp and Zapuni. Merging raises the tier: T1–T2 swing one blade, T3–T4 swing two, and damage per hit goes from 2 (T1) to 4 (T2–T3) to 6 (T4).

Mirage Haze is a new, separate exhaustion. Attacking the same Mirage many times makes each attack cost more Energy Drinks, and this stacks with normal exhaustion. Two schedules are set up: one for Mirages and a gentler one for the bigger Lost City target.

  • Mirages and the Lost City give free daily attacks when they first appear; unused free attacks expire at the end of the day.
  • From 9 December 2026, 00:00 UTC, drinks can also be earned during the enrollment phase (date from the official notes).
  • Mirage and Lost City spawn spots and tile layouts are reshuffled.
  • The Mirage battle results screen shows how many more kills you need to pass the league ahead (for example “3 kills away from No. 1”).
  • Single-attack results get a quick battle-report button, and the rally screen now shows your current exhaustion and its rules.
  • A rally is cancelled automatically if your side captures the target tile before the countdown ends.
  • Friend Spas: if the Goldrush MVP opens their spa within a week after Goldrush ends, their teammates get the same combat stat buffs there. Spas with this bonus are marked.

City of Gold pass and Maple Mansion

A new pass called City of Gold (premium version: Sandy Pass) has 40 levels and four sets of weekly quests. Reaching level 40 requires 3,120 keys in total. After the final level, every 50 additional keys gives 10 Pinballs and 1,000 Candy.

Level 30 rewardTrack
Maple Pinballs (ball skin)Free
Pinball Machine Skin: Maple MansionPremium

Other levels mostly hand out Pinballs, Candy, Tatari Capsules, Tatari Scan Capsules, Bento and Tatari Wishboxes. Buying the premium pass mid-event unlocks the premium rewards for every level you have already reached.

Blueprints and camp encounters

Blueprints let you save your camp layout, share it with friends or post it to a public Blueprint Plaza with Hot Blueprints and favorites. Applying a Blueprint moves your existing buildings into place and offers to buy any missing ones; buildings that can’t be put away stay where they are. Batch selection lets you move or remove several tiles and buildings at once.

Six new camp encounters follow a desert, City of Gold theme: an oasis that turns out to be a mirage, a jar of gold coins that are really chocolate, an antique bronze mirror, a mural of a noble kitty, a hidden sand-bath compartment and a sand-pit trap. They become eligible once an account is at least 10 days old; this does not guarantee an encounter immediately.

EncountersReward per choice
Two encounters30 Pinballs
Three encounters30 Tatari Scan Capsules
One encounter1 Bento
For each of these six encounters, both choices give the same reward. Pick whichever outcome you prefer.

Horde Invasion adjustments

Matching the official notes, many chip and skill descriptions are reworded. Most class and position chips now say “HP” instead of “Max HP”, and the level-up chip now states that only one Tatari is upgraded. Banana Bash no longer says “periodically”.

ZoboChange in this build
Volcano ZoboDeath explosion damage 120% → 90% ATK
Sailor ZoboBarrel damage 50% → 40% ATK; barrel HP growth lowered
Laser ZoboCharged lightning damage 25% → 20% ATK
Pharaoh ZoboDeath-curse Fragile lasts 1.5 s instead of 4 s
Garden ZoboVine damage and vine stun now end after 10 s instead of lasting indefinitely
Shaman ZoboIts debuff can no longer be cleansed
Hydro ZoboIts weakening debuff can no longer be cleansed
The game can now switch itself to Low Performance Mode when the connection is unstable or the frame rate drops, which fits the notes about smoother Horde battles. Performance itself can only be judged in-game.

Artifact Adventure

  • New Adventure Invite: you can notify offline friends that you’re playing Artifact Adventure. They need notifications turned on to receive it.
  • Visual effects are reworked for the deeper layers.
  • The official notes add that Rule of Threes and similar buffs now also apply to artifacts dropped by Zobos; that part can only be checked in-game.

Sparkly Spa details

  • The Spa Station includes friends and teammates from your previous Goldrush. A badge marks spas with a teammate bonus.
  • If the Goldrush MVP opens a spa within one week after Goldrush ends, their Goldrush teammates can receive the same combat stat buffs there. The bonus lasts until that spa closes.
  • Sparkle progress uses the buffs active at the end of the calendar day and must be claimed the following day, including the spa’s final day. Unclaimed progress does not carry over.
  • Upgrading or changing spas does not reset daily trigger limits or alter the previous day’s earned Sparkle progress.
  • Sparkle progress can be assigned to an eligible T4 Tatari with its Glitter form unlocked and Sparkle skins available. Unlocks from a friend’s spa are Standard Sparkle skins; duplicates become Glitter Fruit.

Still unknown

  • Release dates for the new Tatari, Whirling Wallop, the pass and the Maple Mansion skin.
  • How the Sharpup line is obtained.
  • Whether every Pioneer value carries over unchanged to the regular servers.
The Tatari database, calculators and Goldrush guide will be updated once these changes go live on the regular servers.
